instructions:
Repository-specific rules. Each one exists because the opposite mistake was made here at least once.

Do not report a file mode or permission change unless the diff contains explicit `old mode` / `new mode` lines. An `index <a>..<b> 100755` header with a single trailing mode means the mode is unchanged (false positive on PR #1270).

Flag every `memory.metadata.get('tags')`, `metadata.get('memory_type')`, `metadata.get('content_hash')` and `metadata.get('created_at')`. These are top-level attributes of the `Memory` dataclass; the metadata form returns a default silently and has caused three production bugs (PRs #466, #467, #469).

Flag user-provided values interpolated into `logger.*` f-strings without `_sanitize_log_value()` from `mcp_memory_service.compat`. This is CodeQL `py/log-injection` (GHSA-84hp-mqvj-3p8h). Multi-line logger calls count too.

Flag storage queries that read memories without excluding soft-deleted rows. Deletion is a tombstone, so SQL needs `WHERE deleted_at IS NULL` and every backend's `get_by_hash` must filter them - except where an `is_deleted()` path deliberately needs the unfiltered lookup, in which case the two must be split rather than filtered in place.

Issue and PR numbers below #341 in CHANGELOG, README and docs are Codeberg numbers from the pre-migration history. Do not suggest linking them to GitHub issues of the same number and do not report them as wrong references.

Complexity findings on functions the diff does not touch are the file's pre-existing state; report complexity only for functions the change actually modifies.
